profileSummary: Passionate Full Stack Developer specializing in Java Spring Boot, Vue.js, and Generative AI. I love creating innovative solutions that make a difference.
currently: Currently at SpruceInfoTech, working with Arch Mortgage Insurance Company through Infosys.
story: Today I'm a Senior Full Stack Developer at SpruceInfoTech, working with Arch Mortgage Insurance Company as a subcontractor for Infosys.

In 2021 I joined Capgemini and moved into enterprise systems for General Electric and later Subaru, with much of the work focused on upgrading applications the business relies on. I also led a module team, ran knowledge transfers during vendor transitions, and was the Delivery Excellence point of contact for AI and productivity tools.
I started in 2018 at GV Soft Solutions, working across the whole stack on a competitions and collaboration platform: APIs, secure login, Vue.js interfaces and production support.

caseStudies.title: Moving a live access platform from Angular 9 to 19
caseStudies.challenge: WAM decides which roles GE Aerospace users get, through multi-level approval workflows. The platform had to stay up while its whole stack moved forward.
steps: Led the Angular migration using an incremental upgrade strategy.
Upgraded Spring Boot and Node.js, improving security compliance and performance.
Reduced approval workflow latency by optimizing REST APIs and backend queries.
caseStudies.outcome: Migration completed with no production downtime.

caseStudies.title: Splitting one application in two when GE became separate companies
caseStudies.challenge: After the corporate split, GE Vernova needed its own version of WAM, with its own data and its own approval rules.
steps: Led the application fork and enterprise re-platforming.
Migrated and cleaned legacy GE data to match the new organization.
Handed the application over to the Infosys team through knowledge transfer sessions.
caseStudies.outcome: Rolled out to production with no critical post-release defects.

caseStudies.title: Rebuilding a corporate billing tool on a modern full stack
caseStudies.challenge: CATBILL runs monthly billing for GE's corporate air transport through recurring job batches. It was built on Spring MVC and JSP.
steps: Led the full-stack modernization to Spring Boot and React.
Designed backend services and the UI for billing dashboards and reporting.
Owned delivery through deployment and post-production support.
caseStudies.outcome: Delivered and supported in production after go-live.
